mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.nick_name, u.icon, r.content, r.score, r.liked, r.create_time FROM review r JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.spot_id = #{spotId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.spot_id, s.name AS spot_name, r.user_id, r.content, r.score, r.liked, r.create_time FROM review r JOIN spot s ON s.id = r.spot_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC
